user.title: Bestiarium Climate
user.description: Configure capacity and timing for heating/cooling device rotation.

data_description.capacity: How many devices can run simultaneously (0–100)
data_description.min_working_time: Minimum time a device must run before rotation
data_description.recovery_timeout: How long to wait before retrying a non-responding switch

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Bestiarium Climate
reconfigure.description: Update the timing settings. The capacity is changed with the Capacity entity (for example by a power automation); the setup form gives only its initial value.

error.invalid_min_power: Minimum power must be a number

user.title: Add Virtual Switch
user.description: A switch for a thermostat: its actions run as Home Assistant scripts (sequences, conditions, delays). Heating or cooling comes from the thermostats that control it. Its state is read from the power sensor.

data.name: Name
data.min_power: Minimum power (W) to treat device as on

data_description.name: Friendly name for this switch
data_description.heating_action: Runs on "on" when the thermostats of this switch heat (or without a thermostat)
data_description.cooling_action: Runs on "on" when the thermostats of this switch cool
data_description.off_action: Action to run when switch is turned off
data_description.min_power: At or above this power the switch is on
data_description.power_hysteresis_percent: On goes to off only below the minimum power minus this share of it
data_description.power_delay_seconds: A change of the state (and no power data) is shown only after it has lasted this long
data_description.power_tolerance_seconds: No power data is shown (the switch unavailable) only after this long
data_description.power_socket: Optional. The thermostat turns it off (never on) when the device goes on running despite its "off"s. Recommended: the "Allowed" switch of the device's Bestiarium Devices entry. Its relay is not recommended: the Devices balancer may turn it back on, and then the device is turned off again about every 20 minutes, with events. While the socket is off the thermostat shows "No power".

basic.title: Thermostat Settings
basic.description: Any switch (a socket, a relay, a template switch) and the room's temperature sensor. Auto: the balancer shares the capacity; manual: the thermostat heats or cools by itself, outside the capacity, until the red zone.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this thermostat
data_description.target_switch: The switch that powers the device: any switch but the virtual switches of Bestiarium Climate and the relays of Bestiarium Devices
data_description.thermostat_mode: Heating: the manual mode is "heat"; cooling: "cool"
data_description.cold_tolerance: Temperature band below target before turning on
data_description.hot_tolerance: Temperature band above target before turning off
data_description.heater_power: Used to check that a start fits under the red zone. Empty: the expected power of the Bestiarium device of this switch, else 2000 W

power.title: Power
power.description: Optional. With a power sensor the thermostat reads whether the device runs from its power, not from the switch (a cloud or template switch may show a state it does not have).

data.attempts: Attempts to turn on before deferring

data_description.attempts: Balancing cycles (a minute each) a switch may stay off while it should turn on before it is deferred for the recovery timeout
data_description.tolerance_seconds: A switch or temperature sensor gone for less than this is a short dropout, not a problem
data_description.hysteresis_seconds: A problem ends only after this long without it
data_description.off_attempts: A switch that runs while its thermostat wants it off gets this many "off"s, the interval apart; then the event "out of control", and after one more interval its socket is cut
data_description.off_interval_seconds: Between two "off"s, the last "off" and the event, the event and cutting the socket
